report.summary: Payment-service p95 latency increased from 0.24s to 0.94s over a 5‑minute window, indicating degraded performance.

likely_causes.title: Increased traffic load
likely_causes.rationale: Higher request volume can raise latency as the service processes more concurrent requests.

likely_causes.title: Resource contention (CPU/memory)
likely_causes.rationale: Elevated CPU or memory pressure can slow request handling, raising latency.

likely_causes.title: Code regression in payment-service
likely_causes.rationale: Recent code changes may have introduced inefficiencies or blocking operations.

likely_causes.title: External dependency slowdown
likely_causes.rationale: Latency in downstream services (e.g., database, payment gateway) can propagate back to payment-service.

next_steps: Verify current request rate and compare to historical peaks.
Check CPU and memory utilization of payment-service pods.
Review recent deployments or code changes for potential regressions.
Inspect latency of external dependencies (DB, payment gateway) during the incident window.
